## ask-for-help.html
Ask for Help | Flash Forward - Energy Poverty Nonprofit Foundation
Ask for Help
Request support
If your community or organization is seeking solar-powered study lights or related training for students living without reliable electricity, tell us what you need and how it could help students study after dark.
How can we assist?
01
Equipment Requests
Tell us what solar-light equipment your organization needs, who it would support, and how it would be used.
02
Training Requests
Describe the practical training your volunteers need to assemble, use, or distribute solar-powered lights.
03
Equipment Questions
Share questions about intended equipment use so our team can assess what guidance may be available.
04
Community and Partner Context
Tell us about your community, existing partners, and local energy-access needs so our team can assess possible next steps.
How to Request Assistance
To request help, please follow these simple steps:
Complete our application form with details about your community or organization, the type of assistance you need, and how it will benefit your recipients.

## dedicate-solar.html
Request a Solar-Light Dedication | Flash Forward Foundation
Request a Solar-Light Dedication
A solar light can be more than a gift. Request a dedication in someone's name and, once our team confirms it, that request can support a student living without reliable electricity as they learn after dark.
Request a dedication
Request a solar-light dedication in honor or memory of someone, and help support a student living without reliable electricity.
Tell us who you would like to recognize. Our team will confirm whether a dedication is available, what recognition can be offered, and the next steps before you proceed. Confirmed dedication requests support Flash Forward's work to provide solar-powered lights to students living without reliable electricity.
Lights in the right hands
Donations and confirmed dedication requests support Flash Forward's work to build and distribute solar-powered lights for students living without reliable electricity.
Support the program
A donation supports Flash Forward's solar-light work. To request a named dedication, contact our team before donating.
Donate

## donate-equipment.html
Donate Equipment | Flash Forward - Energy Poverty Nonprofit Foundation
Donate Equipment
Why Donate Equipment?
Accepted maker and electronics equipment can give volunteers practical tools for solar-light assembly and testing. Here are some ways suitable equipment may support the mission:
01
Support Volunteer Assembly
Accepted tools and components can support volunteer-led assembly and testing of solar-powered lights for students living without reliable electricity.
02
Strengthen Workshop Capacity
Equipment such as 3D printers and soldering stations can expand the tools available to volunteers building and improving solar-powered lights.
03
Give Suitable Gear a Second Life
Offering used-but-working gear for review may give suitable equipment a second life in the workshop.
04
Tax Considerations
Equipment donations may be tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law. Donors should consult a qualified tax adviser about eligibility and valuation.
How Accepted Equipment Can Help
Suitable equipment may support the work in several practical ways:
Support Light Assembly
Suitable tools can help volunteers assemble and test solar-powered lights more efficiently.
Support Hands-On Learning
When used in approved volunteer activities, equipment can support practical experience with CAD, 3D printing, soldering, and assembly.
Reduce Equipment Purchases
Accepted tools and components may reduce the need to purchase certain workshop equipment for volunteer builds.
Equipment We Can Review
Ask our team whether we can currently accept any of the following. Do not ship or drop off items until acceptance is confirmed:
3D Printers & Filament
Soldering Irons & Stations
Solar Panels & Cells
Rechargeable Batteries & Chargers
LEDs, Wiring & Electronic Components
Multimeters & Hand Tools
Laptops for CAD & Design
How to Donate
Contact us before shipping or dropping off equipment. Our team can review the item, its condition, quantity, location, and whether it fits current workshop needs.
Contact us
Use the form below to describe the equipment, its condition, quantity, and your location.
Confirm Acceptance and Delivery
Please do not ship or drop off equipment until our team confirms whether it can be accepted and discusses delivery options.
Tax Records
If an equipment donation is accepted, ask what written acknowledgment the Foundation can provide. Donors are responsible for valuation and tax reporting.
Offer Equipment for Review
Suitable tools and components can support volunteers building solar-powered lights for students living without reliable electricity. Use the form to tell us what you would like to donate. Our team will review the details and follow up about whether the equipment fits current needs.

## mission.html
Our Why and Mission | Flash Forward - Energy Poverty Nonprofit Foundation
Why reliable light matters after sunset
Scroll down
Our mission
Flash Forward designs, builds, and distributes solar-powered lights for students living without reliable electricity.
We are a volunteer-led, IRS-recognized 501(c)(3) public charity.
Flash Forward began as a student project and grew into a nonprofit focused on helping students keep studying after dark. Our work is carried forward by volunteers, partners, and donors.
Brighter
futures
No student should have to lose study time when the sun goes down. Flash Forward works to expand access to solar-powered study lights, one light at a time.
Students without reliable electricity can have fewer dependable options for reading and studying after dark.
Flash Forward designs rechargeable solar-powered lights to charge during the day and provide light after sunset without a grid connection.
Our goal is to place practical light in students’ hands so they have another option for studying after dark.
A Case for Support
The global energy-access challenge.
Our timeline
2024
Flash Forward Foundation was founded by students and began developing a solar-powered light.
2025
The IRS recognized Flash Forward Foundation as a 501(c)(3) public charity, effective August 5, 2025.
2026
Flash Forward continues its volunteer-led work to build and distribute solar-powered lights for students living without reliable electricity.
Partners
Malaika
Empowers girls and communities in the DR Congo through education, health, and clean water.
COEC Nigeria
Expands access to quality education for children in underserved communities across Nigeria.
Loksadhana
A charitable trust in Maharashtra, India advancing rural education, women’s empowerment, and health.
Rethread Global
A social enterprise creating dignified employment for people rebuilding their lives.
BSREA Bangladesh
Bangladesh’s leading sustainable & renewable energy association, driving clean-energy access.
Brighten Haiti
Brings solar power to schools, hospitals, and families across Haiti via Solar4Schools.

## privacy-policy.html
Privacy Policy | Flash Forward - Energy Poverty Nonprofit Foundation
Privacy Policy
This page explains how Flash Forward Foundation collects, uses, and protects information from visitors to our website, flashforwardfoundation.org.
Updated on August 23, 2026
At Flash Forward Foundation, we take your privacy seriously. Please read this Privacy Policy to learn how we handle your personal information. By using or accessing our website in any manner, you acknowledge that you accept the practices described below.
Your use of the Flash Forward Foundation website is also subject to our Terms of Service, which incorporates this Privacy Policy by reference.
Information We Collect
We collect information you choose to provide, such as your name, email address, phone number, and message when you submit a form. When you donate, a third-party donation service collects and processes the payment and billing information needed to complete the transaction and may provide us with donation records, such as your name, contact information, donation amount, and transaction status. Flash Forward Foundation does not directly collect or store full payment-card details.
How We Use Your Information
We use the information you provide to respond to your message, process volunteer applications, coordinate equipment donations, keep you updated about our programs, and operate, protect, and improve our website and mission. We do not sell your personal information.
How We Share Your Information
We may share your information with service providers who help us operate our website and programs (such as our form-processing and donation partners), when required by law, subpoena, or legal process, to protect the rights, property, or safety of Flash Forward Foundation or others, or in connection with a merger, reorganization, or transfer of some or all of our assets. We may also share aggregated or de-identified information that cannot reasonably be used to identify you.
Data Retention
We retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Policy, comply with our legal and tax obligations as a nonprofit organization, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.
Forms & Third-Party Processors
Contact and volunteer forms are delivered through FormSubmit, a third-party form service. Donations are processed by a third-party donation service. These providers handle information under their own privacy notices and security practices. An embedded donation checkout may also use cookies or similar technologies as described in the donation service’s privacy notice.
Analytics & Cookies
We use Google Analytics, a web analytics service provided by Google, to understand how visitors use our website so we can improve it. Google Analytics uses cookies and similar technologies to collect information such as pages visited, approximate location, device and browser type, and how you arrived at our site; this information is aggregated and is not used to personally identify you. You can control cookies through your browser settings, and you can opt out of Google Analytics across all websites using Google’s browser add-on at tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout. For more information, see Google’s Privacy Policy at policies.google.com/privacy.
International Users
Flash Forward Foundation is based in the United States, and any information you provide will be processed and stored in the United States. If you access our website from outside the United States, you consent to the transfer of your information to the United States, which may have data protection laws different from those in your country.
Do Not Track
Some browsers offer a “Do Not Track” signal. Because there is no common industry standard for how to respond, our website does not currently respond differently based on a Do Not Track signal.
Children’s Privacy
Flash Forward Foundation was founded by students, and many of our volunteers are students themselves. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 without parental involvement. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can remove it.
Data Security
We seek to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, and disclosure using reasonable administrative, technical, and physical security measures. However, no method of transmitting or storing data over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
Your Choices
You may contact us at any time to ask what information we have about you, request a correction, or ask us to delete it, to the extent required by applicable law. Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights under applicable data privacy laws; contact us and we will respond as required by law.
Limitation of Liability
While we take reasonable steps to protect your information, to the fullest extent permitted by law, Flash Forward Foundation is not liable for any unauthorized access to or use of your information, or for the privacy or security practices of any third-party service we use or link to, except as required by applicable law.
Changes to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time as our website and programs grow. Any changes are effective as soon as we post the updated Policy on this page, and your continued use of our website after a change means you accept the updated Policy.
Contact Us
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, contact us at about@flashforwardfoundation.org.

Who We Are
Flash Forward Foundation is a 501(c)(3) public charity (EIN 39-3605570) founded by students. We develop solar-powered study lights for students living without reliable electricity and coordinate volunteer-led design, assembly, fundraising, outreach, and delivery.
Eligibility
You must be at least 13 years old to use our website or submit a form. If you are under 18, you may only use our website and submit forms with the involvement or consent of a parent or guardian. By using our website, you represent that you meet these requirements.

If you choose a recurring donation, it continues at the amount and interval shown at checkout until you cancel it. Flash Forward Foundation is recognized by the IRS as a 501(c)(3) public charity. Donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law. ## volunteering.html
Volunteering | Flash Forward - Energy Poverty Nonprofit Foundation
Volunteer
Help build and deliver solar-powered lights
Flash Forward relies on volunteers to build and deliver solar-powered lights for students living without reliable electricity. Depending on current needs, volunteers may support workshops, outreach, fundraising, or other practical work that keeps the program moving.
Join our Discord
Why volunteer with Flash Forward?
01
Support a student-focused program
Volunteer work can support the design, assembly, fundraising, and distribution efforts behind solar-powered lights for students living without reliable electricity.
02
Build practical experience
Depending on the role and current workshop activity, volunteers may gain hands-on experience with CAD, 3D printing, soldering, testing, or assembly.
03
Contribute to a defined task
Some opportunities may involve supporting a design, outreach, fundraising, or research task from planning through completion.
04
Find a workable commitment
Time commitments vary by role. Tell us your availability so the team can share opportunities that may be a fit.
Engineering & Assembly
Depending on current needs and experience, volunteers may help with CAD, 3D printing, soldering, assembly, testing, or design documentation for solar-powered lights.
Outreach & Partnerships
Volunteers may help research prospective companies, schools, sponsors, or nonprofit partners and support approved outreach.
Social Media & Marketing
Volunteers may help create approved photos, videos, posts, or campaign materials that explain the work behind each light.
Fundraising
Volunteers may support grant research, community fundraisers, donor outreach, or other approved fundraising work.
Volunteer Recruitment
Volunteers may help welcome new participants, share current opportunities, and support recruitment through approved community or online channels.
STEM Education
When supervised programs are available, volunteers may help with hands-on activities about engineering, renewable energy, and solar-powered lights.
Tell us how you would like to help
Tell us your interests, relevant experience, availability, and location. Our team can share current opportunities in workshops, outreach, fundraising, communications, recruitment, or other light-building work.
